Hangta u la ïathuh ïa ki, “U Mika u la leh kumne ïa nga: u la wer nong ïa nga bad nga la long u lyngdoh jong u.”
Kumta ki la ong ha u, “To kylli na u Blei, ngi kyrpad ïa phi, khnang ba ngin dup tip, lada ka jingleit ba ngi leit kan poi bha ne em.”
Uta u lyngdoh u la ïathuh ïa ki, “Khie leit ha ka jingsuk. Ka jingleit lynti jong phi ka long hapoh ka jingsumar u Trai.”

Te kita ki briew san ngut ki la mih bad ki la poi ha Laish. Ki la ïohi ïa ki briew kiba hangta, ba ki im kum ki nong Sidon khlem don jingma ei ei, ki basuk bad ki bapalei; kim duna ei ei katba don ha ka khyndew, bad ki don spah don hajar. Ki jingai ruh na ki nong Sidon bad kim ju ïadei kam dei jam badno badno.
Nangta ki la wan phai sha la ki hynmen para ha Zora bad Eshta-ol. Ki hynmen para ki la kylli ïa kita ki briew, “Aïu phi don ban ïathuh?”
Ki la ong, “Ïeng, ngin leit kiew pyrshah ïa ki. Ngi la ïohi ïa ka ri ba ka long da shisha ka baseisoh. Ne phin ym leh ei ei? Wat leh suki ban leit, ban rung ha ka bad ban dakhol ïa ka ri.
Ynda phi leit, phin lap ba ki briew ki long ki bapalei. Ka ri ka long ka baïar. Da shisha u Blei U la aiti ïa ka ha ki kti jong phi. Ka long ka jaka kaba ym duna ei ei kat kaba don ha ka khyndew.”
Kumta hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah kiba la kieng atiar thma ki la mih na Zora bad Eshta-ol.
Ki la leit kiew bad ki la sher dara ha Kiriath-Jearim ha ri Juda. Na kane ka daw ïa kata ka jaka la khot Mahanehdan haduh kane ka sngi. Ka don shaphang sepngi ka Kiriath-Jearim.
Na kata ka jaka ki la leit sha ri lum Ephraim, top haduh ïing u Mika.

Te kita ki briew san ngut kiba la leit syntiat ïa ka ri Laish ki la ïathuh ïa ki hynmen para jong ki, “Phi tip ba ha kine ki ïing don ka ephod, ki blei ïing, ka dur blei thaw ba la saiñ? To pyrkhat keiñ mynta aïu phin leh.”
Kumta ki la phai shata bad ki la wan poi ha ka ïing uta u Lebi samla, ha ka jaka shong u Mika, bad ki la ai khublei ïa u.
Ki rangbah Dan hynriewspah ngut, ba la kieng bad la ki tiar ïapom, ki la ïeng ha tyngkong ka khyrdop.

Kito ki san ngut kiba la leit syntiat ïa ka ri ki la leit rung bad ki la shim ïa ka ephod, ïa ki blei ïing bad ïa ka dur bleithaw ba la saiñ, katba uta u lyngdoh u la ïeng ha tyngkong ka khyrdop bad ki hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah ba la kieng atiar ïapom.
Hynrei haba kine ki la leit rung hapoh ïing u Mika, bad ki shim ïa ka ephod, ïa ki blei ïing, bad ïa ka dur blei ba la saiñ, uta u lyngdoh u la kylli ïa ki, “Aïu phi leh?”

Te ki la jubab ïa u, “Sngap jar, set da ka kti ïa la ka shyntur. Ale wan bad ngi ban long u kpa bad u lyngdoh jong ngi. Hato lah ba long lyngdoh tang ïa ka ïing uwei u briew, ne ba long lyngdoh ïa kawei ka jait bad ka kur ha Israel?”
Ka dohnud uta u lyngdoh ka la sngewbha. U la shim ïa ka ephod, ïa ki blei ïing bad ïa ka dur blei, bad u la ïaid hapdeng u paidbah.
Kumta ki la phai bad ki la leit, ki pynïaid hakhmat jong ki ïa ki khynnnah, ki jynri bad ki mar ki mata.
Haba ki Dan ki la pajih bha na ïing u Mika, la khot ïa ki para marjan jong u ban beh ïa ki Dan.
Ki la pyrta ïa ki Dan. Kine ki la phai bad ki la ong ïa u Mika, “Phi kwah aïu ba phi ïalam bad phi kat kane ka kynhun?”
U la phai ktien, “Phi rah ïa ki blei ba nga la thaw bad ïa u lyngdoh, bad phi leit noh, te dang sah aïu shuh ïa nga? Te kumno phi kylli ïa nga, ‘Aïu phi kwah?’”
Ki Dan ki la ong ha u, “Wat pyrta shuh ïa ngi, ïoh ngi bitar bad kynrup ïa phi. Hangta phin duh ei la ka jingim bad ka jingim kiba ha ïing ha sem jong phi.”
Nangta ki Dan ki la leit la ka leit. Ynda u Mika u la ïohi ba ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa u, u la leit phai noh sha la ïing.

Te ynda ki la rah noh ïa kata kaba u Mika u la thaw, bad ïa u lyngdoh jong u, ki Dan ki la wan sha Laish sha ki briew ki basuk bad ki bapalei. Ki la pom ïa ki da ka waitlam bad ki la thang ïa ka shnong jong ki da ka ding.
Ym shym la don nongpyllait namarba ka la jngai na Sidon, bad kim ju ïadonkam donjam badno badno. Ka la long ha ka them Beth-Rehob. Ki Dan ki la tei biang ïa ka nongbah bad ki la shong ha ka.
Ki la ai kyrteng Dan ïa ka, da ka kyrteng u kpa tymmen jong ki u Dan, ïa uba la kha ha Israel; hynrei ka kyrteng jong kata ka nongbah ka la long Laish mynshuwa.

Ki Dan ki la pynïeng ïa kata ka blei thaw na ka bynta ïa lade. U Jonathan u khun u Gershom, u khun u Moses, bad ki khun jong u ki la long ki lyngdoh ïa ka jait Dan haduh ka sngi ba la shah ringmraw na kata ka ri.
Kumta ki la pynïeng ïa ka dur blei ba la thaw u Mika, katba ka ïing u Blei ka la don ha Shilo.
Ha kito ki sngi, mynba ym pat don syiem ha Israel, uwei u Lebi uba la shim kawei ka tnga kliar na Bethlehem ha ri Juda, u la shong la sah ha ki thaiñ kiba sha kyndong eh jong ka ri lum Ephraim.
Ka tnga kliar jong u ka la klim ïa u, bad ka la phet noh sha ïing u kpa jong ka ha Bethlehem ha ri Juda, bad ka la sah hangta kumba saw bnai ei ei.

Kumta u tnga jong ka u la leit bud ïa ka, ban khroh ïa ka ban wan noh. U la ïalam uwei u shakri bad ar tylli ki kada. Te u la poi ha ïing u kpa jong ka, bad haba u kpa jong ka khynnah u la ïohi ïa u, u la wan ïakynduh ïa u da ka jingkmen.
Te u kthaw kurim jong u, u kpa jong ka khynnah, u la bat ïa u, bad u la sah bad u lai sngi. Kumta ki la ïabam ïadih, bad ki la sah miet hangta.

Ha ka sngi ka basaw ki la khie dang step, bad u la pynkhreh ban leit. Hynrei u kpa ka khynnah u la ong ha u pyrsa kurim jong u, “Da bam da dih khyndiat keiñ ban khlaiñ ka dohnud jong phi, nangta sa leit.”
Kumta kita ki briew ar ngut ki la ïashong bad ki la ïabam ïadih lang; u kpa kata ka khynnah pat u la ong ha uta u briew, “Sah shuh sa shimiet seh, bad to pynkmen ïa la ka dohnud.”
Te haba uta u briew u la ïeng ban leit, u kthaw kurim jong u u la kyrpad eh haduh ba u la hap sah biang sa shimiet.
Ha ka sngi ka basan u la khie dang step ban mih, hynrei u kpa ka khynnah u la ong, “To pynïaw ïa la ka dohnud bad ap haduh ban da noh ka sngi.” Kumta baroh ar ngut ki la ïabam.

Haba uta u briew, ka tnga kliar bad u shakri jong u ki la ïeng ban mih, u kthaw kurim jong u, u kpa ka khynnah, u la ong, “Ha peit, ka sngi ka la noh sa ban miet artat; to sah noh sa shimiet. Ka sngi ka la jan sep, sah noh bad pynkmen ïa la ka dohnud. Lashai phin sa khie dang step ban leit sha la ïing.”

Uta u briew um treh sah miet shuh. U la ïeng bad u la leit, bad u la poi haduh pyrshah Jebus (kata ka mut, Jerusalem). U ïalam bad u shi jur ki kada ba la teh jin, bad ka tnga kliar jong u ruh ka la don bad u.
Haba ki la poi hajan Jebus, ka sngi ka la jan sep artat. Kumta u shakri u la ong ha u kynrad jong u, “Ynnai leit shuh mynta, ïa ngin ïaleit sah miet noh ha kane ka nongbah ki Jebus.”
Hynrei u kynrad jong u u la jubab, “Ngim dei ban leit rung ha ka nongbah ki nongwei, kibym ïadei jait bad ki paid Israel: ieh ngin ïaid la ka ïaid haduh Gibea.”
Te u la ong ha u shakri jong u, “Ïa ngin ïaleit haduh jan kawei na kine ki jaka, ha Gibea ne Rama bad ngin ïasah miet hangta.”
Kumta ki la ïaid sa ïaid bad ka sngi ka la sep hajan Gibea ka jong ki Benjamin.
Ki la phai shata ban leit sah miet ha Gibea. Ynda rung hapoh shnong ki la ïashong pynban ha lynti shnong namarba ym don ba khot sah miet ïa ki ha ïing jongno jongno.
Kumno re kumno, la wan poi na jyntrei lyngkha ynda janmiet uwei u tymmen. Une u briew u dei na ri lum Ephraim, hynrei u shong u sah ha Gibea, bad ki trai shnong ki dei ki Benjamin.
Haba u la khmied ïa la ki khmat, u la ïohi ïa uta u nongleit jingleit ba u shong ha lynti. U la kylli ïa ki, “Shano phi ïaleit? Bad nangno phi ïawan?”

Te u la ïathuh ïa u, “Ngi ïaleit na Bethlehem ri Juda sha ki thaiñ ba kyndong eh jong ka ri lum Ephraim. Nangne nga la wan bad nga la leit sha Bethlehem ri Juda, te mynta nga leit phai sha la shnong, hynrei ym don ba khot ïa nga ha ïing jongno jongno.
Ngi don la u phlang bad ka jynbam ïa ki kada, u kpu bad ka waiñ ïa lade, ïa ka samla bad ïa u shakri jong ngi. Ngim duna ei ei.”
Uta u tymmen u la ong ïa u, “Ka jingsuk ha phi; ngan sa peit ma nga katba phi donkam, tang ba wat sah miet ha lynti.”
Kumta u la ïalam ïa ki sha ïing lajong, u la ai jynbam ïa ki kada; nangta ki la sait ïa la ki kjat bad ki la bam la dih.

Katba ki dang ïapynsngewbha ïa lade, ki briew nangta na shnong, ki kynja ’riewpohjait, ki la ker tawiar ïa ka ïing bad ki la tied ïa ka jynkhang. Ki la khot ïa u tymmen, u trai kata ka ïing, “Sei ïa uto u briew uba wan ha ïing jong phi ba ngin dup leh sang ïa u.”
Uta u briew, u trai ïing, u la mih bad u la ong ha ki, “Ieh seh, ko hynmen para, wat leh dakaid katne katne. Haba phi ïohi ba wan rung une u briew ha ïing jong nga, wat leh pohjait kumne.
Ha peit, hangne ka don ka khun samla jong nga bad ka tnga kliar jong u; shuh ngan pynmih ïa ki mynta. To leh khlemraiñ ïa ki katba phi sngewdei; hynrei wat leh pohjait kumne ïa une u rangbah.”

Hynrei kita ki briew kim sngap satia. Kumta uta u briew u la shim ïa ka tnga kliar jong u bad u la wanlam ïa ka ha ki. Ki la khñiot ïa ka bad ki la leh sih ïa ka haduh ynda mynstep. Ynda kynjat jingshai ki sa phah noh ïa ka.
Dangbyrngut mynstep, kata ka kynthei ka la wan bad ka la kyllon ha jynkhang jong kata ka ïing ha kaba don u kynrad jong ka, haduh ban da shai.
Haba u kynrad jong ka u la khie mynstep bad u la plie ïa ka jynkhang ban leit noh, hakhmih kane ka tnga kliar jong u ka thiah ha dwar ïing bad ki kti ha mar tyngkong.
U la ong ïa ka, “Khie joit, ïa noh.” Kam thie satia. Kumta u la kyntiew ïa ka halor ka kada, bad u la leit shaduh shnong lajong.
U tang shu rung hapoh ïing, u la shim kawei ka tari, u la bat ïa ka tnga kliar jong u bad u la tar lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ka khat-ar nuid, nangta u la phah ïa ki sha ki dong baroh jong ka ri Israel.

Baroh kiba la ïohi ïa kane ki la ïa-ong, “Kum kane kaei kaei ym pat ju jia ne ym pat ju ïohi naduh ka sngi ba ki paid Israel ki la mih na ri Ijipt haduh kane ka sngi. To ïapyrkhat, to ïawad jingmut, bad to ïakren shaphang kane.”
Te ki paid Israel baroh ki la ïamih, naduh Dan haduh Beer-sheba, don ruh na ri Gilead, bad u paidbah u la ïasynjuk lang shi mynsiem ha u Trai ha Mizpa.
Ki tymmen ki san jong u paid baroh, jong ki jait Israel baroh, ki la ïadon lang ha kata ka jingïalang jong u paid u Blei sawspah hajar ki shipai ïaid kjat kiba lah ban rah wait.
(Ki Benjamin ki la ïohsngew ba u paid Israel u la ïaleit sha Mizpa). Ki paid Israel ki la ong, “Ïathuh ïa ngi, kumno kane ka kam runar ka la jia?”
U Lebi, u tnga ka kynthei ba shah pynïap u la jubab kumne, “Nga la wan poi sha Gibea, ka muluk ki Benjamin, ma nga bad ka tnga kliar jong nga, ban sah miet.
Ki nong Gibea ki la ïeng pyrshah ïa nga, bad ki la ker tawiar mynmiet ïa ka ïing ba nga don. Ki la mut ban pynïap ïa nga, bad ki la leh khlemraiñ ïa ka tnga kliar jong nga haduh ba kan da ïap.
Kumta nga la shim ïa ka tnga kliar jong nga, nga la ot nuid ïa ka bad nga la phah ïa ka kylleng ka ri ba ïoh kynti ki Israel, namar ki la leh ka kam ka ba-ijli bad ka balehraiñ ha Israel.
Peit ma phi, ki paid Israel, baroh ma phi, to ïapyni jingmut bad ïapyrkhat lang hangne.”
Te ki paid baroh ki la ïeng shi tylli, ki ong, “Uno uno ruh na ngi un ym leit phai sha la ka ïing jaiñ lymne sha la ïing.
Ngin leh kumne ïa ka Gibea: ngin ïaleh ïa ka da kaba shu khalai nusib.

Ngin shim shiphew ngut na man ki shispah jong ki jait Israel baroh, shispah na ki shihajar, bad shihajar na ki shiphew hajar, ban wan rah jynbam na ka bynta ki paid bad ynda ki la wan, ki lah ban ai ka nongkylliang ïa ka Gibea jong ki Benjamin na ka bynta ka kam dakaid kaba ki la leh ha Israel.”
Kumta ki rangbah Israel baroh ki la ïatylli kawei bad ki la ïakhih pyrshah kata ka nongbah.
Hadien kane, ki jait Israel ki la phah da ki briew sha ka jait Benjamin ban kylli, “Ka jingdakaid aïu kaba kat kane ka la jia hapdeng jong phi?

Namarkata, aiti ha ngi ïa kito ki ’riewpohjait ha Gibea ba ngin pynïap ïa ki, bad ban pynduh ïa ka jingsniew na Israel.” Hynrei ki Benjamin kim treh pdiang ïa ka jingong ki hynmen para jong ki, ki paid Israel.
Kumta ki Benjamin ki la ïamih na la ki shnong ban leit sha Gibea, ban ïaleh thma pyrshah u paid Israel.
Ki Benjamin ki la pynlang briew ha kata ka sngi arphew hynriew hajar ngut ki ’rangbahwait halor ki nong Gibea kiba la pynlang hynñiewspah ngut ki ’rangdajied.
Hapdeng kine baroh la don hynñiewspah ngut ki ’rangdajied kiba trei kadiang. Uwei pa uwei u lah ban dei wat ïa u shñiuh haba kawang maw, bad um lait.
Ki rangbah Israel, lait noh ki Benjamin, ki la pynlang briew sawspah hajar ngut ki ’rangbahwait. Baroh ki dei ki ’riewthma.
Ki paid Israel ki la ïeng bad ki la leit sha Bethel ban wad jingmut na u Blei, “Mano na ngi ban ïaleh thma nyngkong pyrshah ïa ki Benjamin.” U Trai U la jubab, “Ki Juda kin leit nyngkong.”
Kumta ki paid Israel ki la khie dang step bad ki la sher dara pyrshah ka Gibea.
Ki rangbah ka Israel ki la ïeng da ka thma pyrshah ki Benjamin bad ki la khreh ïaleh ïa ki ha Gibea.
Ki Benjamin ki la mih na Gibea bad ki la pynkyllon ha kata ka sngi arphew ar hajar ngut ki Israel.
Hynrei ki paid, ki rangbah Israel ki la leh shlur biang bad ki la pynap ïaleh ha kajuh ka jaka ha kaba ki la pynkhreh ha ka sngi ka banyngkong.

Ki paid Israel ki la leit kiew bad ki la ïam ha khmat u Trai haduh ynda janmiet nangta ki la wad jingmut na u Trai, “Hato ngin dang leit ïaleh thma biang ïa ki hynmen para jong ngi ki Benjamin?” Te u Trai U la ong, “Khie leit pyrshah ïa ki.”
Kumta ki paid Israel ki la tur pyrshah ki Benjamin ha ka sngi ba-ar.
Bad ki Benjamin ki la pynkyllon khatphra hajar ngut na ki paid Israel; baroh ki dei tang ki ’rangbahwait.

Hangta u paid Israel baroh, ka kynhun shipai baroh, ki la leit kiew sha Bethel bad ki la ïam. Ki la shong hangta hakhmat u Trai, ki la shah jingit haduh ynda janmiet, bad ki la tyrwa ki jynkñia thang bad ki jynkñia ïabha ïamiat hakhmat u Trai.
Ki paid Israel ki la wad jingmut na u Trai (ka synduk ka jutang u Blei ka la don hangta ha kito ki sngi,

bad u Phinehas, u khun u Eleasar, u khun u Aron, u la shakri hakhmat jong ka ha kito ki sngi), ki ong, “Hato ngin dang leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ki hynmen para jong ngi ki Benjamin, ne ngin keiñ noh?” Te u Trai u la ong, “Khie leit kiew; lashai Ngan aiti ïa ki ha ka kti jong phi.”
Kumta ki Israel ki la buh briew ban ap ktem sawdong ka Gibea.
Ki paid Israel ki la leit kiew pyrshah ki Benjamin ha ka sngi ka balai, bad ki la pynkhreh ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Gibea kum ha kiwei ki sien.

Ki Benjamin ki la tur shabar pyrshah ki paid bad ïa ki la ring pah ban mih na shnong. Kum ha kiwei ki sien ki la sdang ban pom pynïap katto katne ki briew ha ki surok bah, kawei kaba leit sha Bethel, kawei pat sha Gibea, bad ha ki jaka rud nong ki la ïoh kumba laiphew ngut ki Israel.
Ki Benjamin ki la ïa-ong, “Ki la shah rem hakhmat jong ngi kum mynshuwa.” Ki Israel pat ki la ong, “Ïa ngin phet ban ring pah ïa ki ha ki surok bah ba kin jngai na shnong.”

Hangta ki rangbah Israel ki la mih shabar na ki jaka jong ki, bad ki la pynkhreh ïaleh ha Baal-tamar, katba ki briew ka Israel kiba ap thap ha ki ktem ki la mih bluit na ki jaka jong ki shaphang sepngi na Gibea.
La tur pyrshah ïa ka Gibea shiphew hajar ngut ki ’rangdajied na Israel baroh, bad ka thma ka la long ka batyngeh. Hynrei ki Benjamin kim pat tip ba ka jingjot ka bakhraw ka la lap ïa ki.
U Trai U la pynshah rem ïa ki Benjamin hakhmat ki Israel. Ki rangbah Israel ki la pynïap arphewsan hajar shispah ngut ki Benjamin ha kata ka sngi. Kine baroh ki dei ki ’rangbahwait.
Ki paid Israel ki la ran dadien na ki Benjamin namarba ki la sngewshaniah ha ki briew ba la pynap ktem pyrshah ka Gibea.
Kumta ki Benjamin ki la ïohi ba ïa ki la jop.
Ki briew kiba la ap ktem ki la mih kynsan kynsan, ki la tur pyrshah ka Gibea bad ki la pom ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei da ka waitlam.
Ka dak ba la ïapynbeit hapdeng ki paid Israel bad ki paid ap ktem ka la long ba haba la mih u lyoh tdem u bajrong na ka nongbah,

kiwei pat ki paid Israel kin tur ban ïaleh. Mynta ki Benjamin ki la sdang ban ïaleh bad ki la pynïap kumba laiphew ngut ki Israel. Ki la ong, “Katto ki la shah rem hakhmat jong ngi, kum ha ka thma banyngkong.”
Hynrei ynda ka dak ka la sdang ban mih na ka nongbah da u rishot tdem, ki Benjamin ki la phai dien bad ki la ïohi ba ka nongbah baroh kawei ka la pluh da ka ding kaba la kiew sha bneng.
Hangta ki Israel ki la phai, bad ki Benjamin ki la khaw-eit, namar ki la ïohi ba ka jingjot ka la lap ïa ki.
Kumta ki la phai nakhmat ki paid Israel sha ki phang ri kynjah. Hynrei ka thma ka la lap ïa ki, namar kito kiba mih na ka nongbah ki la poi kloi hapdeng jong ki bad ki la pynïap ïa ki.
Da kaba ker sawdong ïa ki Benjamin, ki la beh bad ki la ïuh roit ïa ki naduh Noha haduh Gibea phang mihngi.
Khatphra hajar ki Benjamin ki la kyllon, baroh tang ki ’riewshlur suda.
Nangta ki la phet shaphang ri kynjah sha u mawsiang Rimmon; sanhajar na ki ki la shah pom ha ki surok bah; ïa kiwei pat la beh haduh Gideon bad sa arhajar ngut ki la shah pynïap.
Kumta baroh kito kiba la kyllon na ki Benjamin ha kata ka sngi ki la long arphewsan hajar ki ’rangbahwait, baroh ki ’riewshlur suda.
Hynrei hynriewspah ngut kiba la phet sha ri kynjah, ki la poi sha u mawsiang Rimmon bad ki la sah hangta saw bnai.
Ki paid Israel ki la wan phai lyngba ka thaiñ ki Benjamin, bad ki pom ïa ki da ka waitlam, bad briew bad mrad katba ïoh. Ïa ki shnong ruh katba ki ïoh ki la thang da ka ding.
Ki rangbah Israel ki la smai ha Mizpa, “Mano mano na ngi um dei ban ai shongkha ïa la ka khun kynthei ha u Benjamin.”
Te ki paid ki la wan sha Bethel, ki la ïashong haduh janmiet hakhmat u Blei, ki da pyrta jam bad ki da ïam kthang.
Ki la ong, “A Trai u Blei ka Israel, balei la jia kum kane ha Israel, ba yn duna noh mynta ka sngi kawei ka jait Israel?”
Ynda kum lashai ki paid ki la khie dang step, ki la tei ka duwan, bad ki la tyrwa jynkñia thang bad jynkñia ïabha ïamiat.

Te ki paid Israel ki la kylli, “Na ki jait Israel baroh, don uno uno ubym shym wan mih sha ka jingïalang ha u Trai?” Namar ki la lah smai tyngeh shaphang uno uno ubym wan sha u Trai ha Mizpa, da kaba ong, “U dei ban shah pynïap.”
Ki paid Israel ki la sngewsynei ïa u Benjamin u para jong ki, bad ki la ong, “Ïa kawei ka jait la ot noh na Israel mynta ka sngi.
Hato ngin leh kumno ban ïoh tnga na ka bynta kito kiba dang sah, namar ngi la smai da u Trai ba ngin ym ai ïano ïano na ki khun kynthei jong ngi ban long ki tnga jong ki?”
Hangta ki la kylli, “Mano keiñ na ki jait Israel kibym shym wan mih ha u Trai ha Mizpa?” La shem ba na Jabesh-Gilead ym shym don ba wan sha ka dara jingïalang.
Mynba la khot lang ïa ki paid, pleng ym shym don wat uwei na ki trai shnong Jabesh-Gilead.

Kumta ka jingïalang paidbah ka la phah shata khat-ar hajar ki rangbah ki bashlur tam bad ki la hukum ïa ki, “Khie pom ïa ki trai shnong Jabesh-Gilead da ka waitlam, wat ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah ruh.
Kumne phi dei ban leh: ïa u shynrang baroh bad ïa ka kynthei baroh kabym sotti shuh phi dei ban pynïap.”
Hynrei ki la lap hapdeng ki trai shnong Jabesh-Gilead sawspah ngut ki ’theisamla kiba dang sotti bad ki la ïalam ïa ki sha ka dara ha Shilo, kaba ha ri Kanaan.
Kumta kata ka jingïalang paidbah ka la phah ktien sha ki Benjamin kiba don ha u mawsiang Rimmon, bad ki la pynbna ba la ïasuk bad ki.
Ki Benjamin ki la wan phai ha kata ka por, bad ki jait Israel ki la ai ha ki ïa ki kynthei ba ki la pyllait im na Jebesh-Gilead. Hynrei kine kim pat biang ïa ki.
Ki paid ki la sngewsynei ïa ki Benjamin, namar u Trai U la pynpait ïa ki jait Israel.
Te ki tymmen ki san kata ka jingïalang ki la ong, “Ngin leh kumno ban ïoh tnga na ka bynta kito kiba dang sah, namar la lah pynïap lut ïa ki kynthei Benjamin?”
Ki la ong, “Dei ban ai khun ïa ki Benjamin kiba dang im, khnang ba kawei ka jait kan ym jah na Israel.
Hynrei ngim lah ban ai tnga ïa ki da ki khun kynthei jong ngi.” Naba ki paid Israel ki la lah smai, “Long ba la tim uta uba ai tnga ïa u Benjamin.”

Nangta ki la pyrkhat, “Ha peit, don ka jinglehniam ha u Trai kaba shisien shisnem ha Shilo, shatei na Bethel, shaphang mihngi ka surok bah kaba leit kiew na Bethel sha Shekhem, shaphang shatei ka Lebona.”
Kumta ki la bthah ïa ki Benjamin kumne, “Phi khie leit rieh ha ki brisoh waiñ,

bad ap hangta. Haba ki khun kynthei Shilo ki mih ban shad, mih ma phi ruh na ki brisoh waiñ bad shim ñiat mar kawei kawei ka tnga na ki khun kynthei ka Shilo, bad nangta phet bak sha la ka ri Benjamin.

Ynda ki kpa ne ki hynmen para jong ki ki wan ud ha ngi, ngin sa ong kumne ha ki, ‘To ai da kaba sngewbha ïa ki ha ngi, namar ha ka thma ngim shym shim mar kawei kawei ka tnga ïa lade; nalor kata lada phim shym la ai hi ma phi ha ngi, phin ym da sngewrem mynta.’ ”

Ki Benjamin ki la leh kumta. Katta ngut katba ki ïadon, ki la ïashim tnga mar kawei kawei napdeng ki nongshad da kaba ki shu rong noh ïa ki. Hadien kata, ki la leit phai sha la ka ri kynti, bad ki la tei biang ïa ki nongbah bad ki la shong la sah hangta.
Ki paid Israel ki la mih nangta ha kata ka por, bad man la u rangbah u la leit sha la ka jait bad ka ïing ka sem, sha la ka ri kynti.
Ha kito ki sngi ym don syiem ha Israel, bad uwei pa uwei u briew u la leh katba u sngewdei.
